name: sigess-extension
description: Automatiza logins e preenchimento de formulários em sites governamentais

scripts.dev:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext run --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.package: npm run build:firefox && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --overwrite-dest
scripts.update-manifest: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const pkg=require('./package.json'); const upd=require('./updates.json'); const addonId='{e9df396f-bdd8-4e79-bc7c-92017a928891}'; if(!upd.addons[addonId].updates.find(u=>u.version===pkg.version)){upd.addons[addonId].updates.unshift({version:pkg.version, update_link:`https://github.com/jcvb2003/SIGESS-Extensao/releases/download/v${pkg.version}/sigess.xpi`}); fs.writeFileSync('./updates.json', JSON.stringify(upd, null, 2)); console.log('Updated updates.json to version ' + pkg.version)}else{console.log('Version already in updates.json')}"
scripts.sign: npm run build:firefox && web-ext sign --api-key %WEB_EXT_API_KEY% --api-secret %WEB_EXT_API_SECRET% --source-dir dist/firefox --channel unlisted
